ufa.py.summary: Print the decoded form of each ``\uXXXX`` escape found in the lines of text files.
details: Prefixes every line with ``\u``, decodes it with the ``unicode_escape`` codec and prints the escaped and the decoded line side by side; binary files are skipped.

uncomment.py.summary: Remove the comments from source files with tree-sitter, keeping the licences.
details: Supports many languages through per-language grammars, preserves the copyright headers, the SPDX lines and the lint directives (also the CGo preamble in Go files), validates each result before writing and offers ``--backup``, ``--dry-run``, ``--verbose``, a pool method and a log file.

unflatten.py.summary: Rebuild a readable shell script from its flattened Python form.
details: Tokenizes the flattened input, splits it back into statements, restores the indentation of the blocks and rewrites the heredocs that had been flattened, optionally formatting the result with black and extracting the heredoc bodies to files.

update_abi.py.summary: Point the ``abi`` of the ``setup.py`` files below the current directory at the running CPython.
details: Derives ``cp3N`` from the interpreter version, rewrites the ``Cython/python abi=`` entries that use another version and reports the touched files.

update_custom_dict.py.summary: Build a word-frequency JSON from the files below the current directory.
details: Tokenizes the text files (regex by default, or nltk, blingfire, sacremoses, spacy, pyonmttok) in a pool, counts the words and writes them to ``word_freq.json`` for the ``~/.personal_dict`` used by the spelling tools.

update_summary.py.summary: Regenerate ``SUMMARY.md`` from the Markdown files of a book tree.
details: Collects every ``.md`` file below the current directory, turns the paths into chapter titles and rewrites ``SUMMARY.md`` with the sorted link list below the existing header.

url2pdf.py.summary: Render a web page to PDF with WeasyPrint.
details: Passes the URL straight to ``weasyprint.HTML`` and writes the PDF; the entry point uses the fixed ``https://example.com`` demo values, so import :func:`convert_url_to_pdf` to convert another page.

url2pdf2.py.summary: Save a web page as PDF with pdfkit, named after the site.
details: Takes the URL on the command line, derives a safe file name from the host (``www.`` removed) and writes ``<host>.pdf`` through ``pdfkit.from_url``.

url2pdf3.py.summary: Save a web page as PDF with pdfkit, reporting the errors.
details: Normalises the URL, names the output after the sanitised domain, converts it with pdfkit and returns a non-zero exit status when the conversion fails.

``get_resource`` fetches a URL (or a local path/``file:`` URI) and returns its bytes, ``save_file`` stores it under the name derived from the URL (with a checksum for the duplicates) and the ``SaveToDisk`` stream wrapper adds a progress report while writing.
urldownloader.py.notes: Library module without a ``__main__`` entry point; importing it does nothing.

uzz.py.summary: Unpack the ``.whl``/``.zip`` archives of a directory in place.
details: Extracts every wheel below the given directory into the same folder and deletes the archive, keeping the original when it is not a valid ZIP or cannot be written.

valhtml.py.summary: Check HTML files for unbalanced tags with several parsers.
details: ``--backend`` selects ``html.parser`` (default), lxml, html5lib, BeautifulSoup or tidy; each backend reports the mismatched closing tags, the unclosed elements and the stray end tags of the files below the current directory.

validate_cpp_syntax.py.summary: Syntax-check C and C++ sources and headers with the compiler.
details: Chooses gcc or g++ by suffix, runs ``-fsyntax-only`` on each file of the tree (or of the given paths) in a process pool and prints the files that fail.

vcf2json.py.summary: Convert a vCard file to JSON.
details: Parses the ``BEGIN:VCARD`` blocks, unfolds the continued lines, decodes the quoted-printable values and writes the contacts as a JSON list.
